name: Rwanda Revenue Authority Volleyball Club
source: The New Times, rra.gov.rw and the club's own X account. Commonly styled RRA WVC.

name: Rwanda Polytechnic Huye College
source: The New Times season preview spells the code out in full; the federation posts it as 'RP Huye'. Formerly IPRC Huye. NOT the same club as RPN (RP Ngoma) in the men's league.

name: Ruhango Volleyball Club
source: The New Times spells 'Ruhango Volleyball Club (RVC)'; rra.gov.rw and Kigali Today corroborate. City inferred from the club name rather than an explicit statement.

name: APR Volleyball Club
source: @AprVolleyball, whose profile identifies it as the men's volleyball section. A genuine volleyball crest, not the football club's.
note: 224px original despite the _400x400 path, and a Twitter avatar URL changes when the club changes its picture. Replace with a club-supplied file when one is available.

name: Police Volleyball Club
source: @rnpvcofficial. FIVB names the club 'Police Volleyball Club'. The crest is volleyball-specific - a dove on a volleyball above a net - not the RNP institutional emblem and not Police FC's football crest.
note: A Twitter avatar URL changes when the club changes its picture.

name: Rwanda Energy Group Volleyball Club
source: reg.rw's own newsroom, The New Times and KT Press all pair the code with this name.
note: No crest exists. Every source shows the Rwanda Energy Group corporate wordmark, which is a wide horizontal mark that would look broken in a crest slot, and the club's X avatar is a squad photo. Generated shield instead.

name: East African University Rwanda
source: The New Times season report pairs the federation's EAU code with this name; eaur.ac.rw confirms the institution.
note: This is the UNIVERSITY's crest, not a volleyball-specific one - normal for a university side, but say so if asked. The university's own 100px transparent PNG is cleaner but too small.
